text:
Good morning,

I am writing to inquire about hiring your Fenwick for my daughter's wedding. The event will take place on 25/03/2027, from 11 am until 7.30pm. We will be collecting the vehicle from your garage. I would like to request that it be driven by one of your chauffeurs, and decorated with ribbons and flowers. I have attached a copy of my driving licence for your reference.

Sincerely,
Milo Corbyngton
+70 519 568 5481
